name: Leong Hup International Berhad
summary: Leong Hup International Berhad operates as a poultry producers in Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Vietnam, and the Philippines. It operates in two segments: Livestock and Poultry related Products and Feedmill. It involved in the production and distribution of breeder and broiler day-old-chick, broiler chickens, eggs, animal feeds, animal health products, consumer food products, and sales of food and beverage. The company also provides food processing products, such as sausages, frankfurters, nuggets, chicken tempura, frozen seafood and meat, and marinated meat products.
